name: tdd-guard
description: Blocks Write/Edit/MultiEdit/TodoWrite calls that skip the test-first loop or over-implement beyond the current failing test, using your project's own test reporter (Vitest, Jest, pytest, Go, Rust, RSpec, Minitest...). Also validates on UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart. Note: the upstream project (nizos/tdd-guard) says its successor 'probity' (nizos/probity) is now the recommended choice for new projects.
